```lean
theorem lg_target {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [SetLike S R] (s : S) [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [SubsemiringClass S R] : IsOrderedRing ↥s := by
  have semiring_s : Semiring ↥s := SubsemiringClass.toSemiring s
  have partial_order_s : PartialOrder ↥s := SubsemiringClass.toPartialOrder s
  have add_compatible : ∀ a b : ↥s, (a + b : R) ≥ 0 → a ≥ 0 ∧ b ≥ 0 → a + b ≥ 0 :=
    fun a b h => by
      have h' : (a + b : R) ≥ 0 := h
      have h1 : a ≥ 0 := by
        rcases IsOrderedRing.add_nonneg_iff_nonneg _ _ h' with ⟨h2, h3⟩
        exact h2
      have h2 : b ≥ 0 := by
        rcases IsOrderedRing.add_nonneg_iff_nonneg _ _ h' with ⟨h2, h3⟩
        exact h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have mul_compatible : ∀ a b : ↥s, (a * b : R) ≥ 0 → a ≥ 0 ∧ b ≥ 0 → a * b ≥ 0 :=
    fun a b h => by
      have h' : (a * b : R) ≥ 0 := h
      have h1 : a ≥ 0 := by
        rcases IsOrderedRing.mul_nonneg_iff_nonneg _ _ h' with ⟨h2, h3⟩
        exact h2
      have h2 : b ≥ 0 := by
        rcases IsOrderedRing.mul_nonneg_iff_nonneg _ _ h' with ⟨h2, h3⟩
        exact h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have total_order_s : ∀ a b : ↥s, a ≥ b ∨ b ≥ a :=
    fun a b => by
      have h : (a - b : R) ≥ 0 ∨ (b - a : R) ≥ 0 :=
        IsOrderedRing.total_order_antisymm_iff (SubsemiringClass.toSubring s) a b
      cases h with h1 h2
      exact Or.inl h1
      exact Or.inr h2
  exact IsOrderedRing.ofSemiringAndPartialOrderAndAddCompatAndMulCompatAndTotal
    semiring_s partial_order_s add_compatible mul_compatible total_order_s
```
